```bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}" VARIABLE_NAME="OPENAI_BASE_URL" VARIABLE_VALUE="${{env:AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT}}/openai/v1" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

bicep = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve() / "infra" / "azure.bicep"
name = os.environ["VARIABLE_NAME"]
value = os.environ["VARIABLE_VALUE"]
if not value:
    raise AssertionError("The variable value resolved to nothing")
lines = bicep.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
headers = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == "appSettings: ["]
if len(headers) != 1:
    raise AssertionError("The App Service must declare exactly one appSettings array")
name_line = "name: '" + name + "'"
if any(line.strip() == name_line for line in lines):
    raise AssertionError("The remote environment variable already exists")
header = headers[0]
indent = " " * (len(lines[header]) - len(lines[header].lstrip()) + 2)
entry = [
    indent + "{",
    indent + "  " + name_line,
    indent + "  value: '" + value + "'",
    indent + "}",
]
lines[header + 1:header + 1] = entry
bicep.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
written = bicep.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
if sum(line.strip() == name_line for line in written) != 1:
    raise AssertionError("The remote environment variable was not written exactly once")
PY
```
